title: Data & Knowledge Management
summary: This module handles all aspects of data and knowledge within CrewAI, including file management, various knowledge sources, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, and memory analysis for agents.

nodes.label: File Management
nodes.title: File Management
nodes.description: Manages file operations, including caching, cleanup, and resolution of various file sources, ensuring efficient and secure file handling within the system.

nodes.label: Knowledge Sources
nodes.title: Knowledge Sources
nodes.description: Provides various knowledge source implementations for loading and processing data from different file types, including general files, Docling-supported documents, and Excel spreadsheets.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.title: RAG System
nodes.description: The RAG System module provides tools and configurations for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enabling integration with various vector databases like ChromaDB and Qdrant for efficient document retrieval and embedding.

nodes.label: Memory Management
nodes.title: Memory Management
nodes.description: This module provides functions for analyzing memory content to determine its scope, categories, and importance for storage, and for consolidating new memory with existing records.

nodes.label: LLM Integration
nodes.title: LLM Integration
nodes.description: Handles interactions with various Large Language Models (LLMs) for processing and generating text.

groups.label: Data Ingestion & Storage
groups.title: Data Ingestion and Storage
groups.description: Components responsible for handling raw files, parsing them into usable knowledge, and preparing data for further processing.

groups.label: Knowledge Processing
groups.title: Knowledge Processing
groups.description: Modules that process ingested data into retrievable knowledge and manage the agent's memory, including analysis and consolidation.

groups.label: Core Dependencies
groups.title: Core Dependencies
groups.description: Essential external systems and capabilities that underpin the functionality of many tools within this module.
